Verified readiness findings

Major SD-A11Y-002

Cart link cannot receive keyboard focus

accessibility-smoke · Chromium desktop 1440x900

Reproduction

  1. Log in as standard_user.
  2. Add a product using the keyboard.
  3. Attempt to focus and activate the cart link using the keyboard.

Expected

The cart control participates in focus order and opens the cart when activated.

Actual

Add to cart supports keyboard activation, but the cart link remains unfocused and cannot be keyboard-activated.

Recommendation

Render the cart as a real anchor with href or an equivalent keyboard-focusable control with correct semantics.

Minor SD-A11Y-001

Inventory lacks primary semantic landmarks

accessibility-smoke · Chromium desktop 1440x900

Reproduction

  1. Log in as standard_user.
  2. Open the product inventory.
  3. Inspect the document landmarks and heading hierarchy.

Expected

The inventory exposes exactly one main landmark and one level-one heading.

Actual

The page exposes no main landmark and no level-one heading.

Recommendation

Wrap primary inventory content in a main landmark and expose Products as the page H1.

Minor SD-NET-001

Reloading inventory returns HTTP 404

network-health · Chromium desktop 1440x900

Reproduction

  1. Log in as standard_user.
  2. Add two products to the cart.
  3. Reload inventory.html.
  4. Inspect the response and browser console.

Expected

The active application route reloads with HTTP 200 and no console error.

Actual

Inventory remains usable and cart state persists, but the document response is HTTP 404 and produces a console error.

Recommendation

Configure the host to serve the application shell with HTTP 200 for supported client-side routes.

Minor SD-RESP-001

Mobile product cards contain excessive vertical whitespace

responsive · Chromium mobile 390x844

Reproduction

  1. Log in as standard_user at a 390x844 viewport.
  2. Scroll through all six inventory products.
  3. Compare the description, price, and action spacing within each card.

Expected

Mobile cards keep related content compact enough for efficient catalog scanning.

Actual

Large empty areas separate descriptions from prices and actions, expanding the six-product page to 5,349 pixels.

Recommendation

Remove fixed or oversized card heights on narrow screens and let cards size to their content.
